source.binding: sourceFinal(source) returns the original string object unchanged
source.caseAdmissionInvariant: Reject any source or objective whose frozen V15/C parse or trim would alter its string; do not normalize the SOURCE arm.

v15.request: reconstructionRequestSchema.parse({source, profile: PRESETS.natural}); exact objective string, no refinement or voiceprint
v15.editor: one frontier-editor StructuredCaller invocation using frozen RECONSTRUCTION_V15 prompt, candidateSchema {text,changes}
v15.rawCustody: Caller wrapper persists exact semantic editor request, returned data plus allowlisted metadata, and candidate.text UTF-8 bytes with readback equality before returning to frozen V15.
v15.verifier: Frozen deterministic directive-scoped temporal verification then distinct candidate-verifier StructuredCaller; strict candidateReviewSchemaV10.
v15.repair: At most one local-repair StructuredCaller attempt and whole-result recheck when frozen V15 requests it.
v15.fallback: Frozen V15 returns source on invalid/unavailable editor, hard meaning failure, rejected/malformed/unavailable verifier, failed repair, or timeout; capture failure yields technical absence for the C pair.
v15.finalCustody: Persist separate V15 verifier/repair semantic request-response payloads and complete V15 result before Candidate C receives RAW.

candidateC.input: Exact readback UTF-8 bytes of V15 candidate.text, asserted byte-equal; same source, objective and PRESETS.natural profile.
candidateC.verifier: Separate post-v3-review and optional post-v3-recheck StructuredCaller invocations using strict postV3ReviewSchema.
candidateC.repair: At most one bounded post-v3-local-repair StructuredCaller invocation using strict postV3RepairSchema.
candidateC.fallback: Frozen C abstains to source on unsafe, unresolved or technical review/repair path; no substitute RAW if V15 RAW absent.
candidateC.traceCustody: Persist C verifier/repair semantic request-response payloads separately from V15 and persist complete C result.

astraDirect.instruction: Exact frozen editor instruction bytes minus one terminal LF
astraDirect.input: One input_text item with exact JSON.stringify({source,objective}); no prelabels or repository data
astraDirect.output: Strict text.format json_schema astra_direct_edit_v1 with edited_text only
astraDirect.servedRevision: UNVERIFIED / not currently available; NOT EXPOSED is acceptable when API does not expose immutable revision
astraDirect.metadataSurface: Authenticated non-inference GET /v1/models/{model} can provide basic model/permissioning metadata; it cannot prove high-effort request acceptance or the eventual served revision.

spendAuthorization.basis: Committed preregistration says no inference or experimental spend is authorized by preregistration alone; Astra spend requires independent authorization before any call.

technicalFailurePolicy.astra: Unavailable model, refusal, timeout, malformed/schema/empty/oversize output or service error: durable technical absence, no retry and no replacement.
technicalFailurePolicy.v15: Frozen source fallback is retained with explicit technical trace; missing valid recorded editor RAW means Candidate C does not run.
technicalFailurePolicy.candidateC: Frozen abstention/source return and technical trace are retained; no alternate RAW and no independent editor generation.
technicalFailurePolicy.custody: Failed exact write/readback prevents C; no silent use of unrecorded RAW.
technicalFailurePolicy.advancement: Any technical absence prevents 48/48 positive advancement; no case or output replacement.
